name: orderflow
description: OrderFlow — e-commerce order, inventory, payment-webhook, and notification system

scripts.build: npm run build -w @orderflow/shared && npm run build -w @orderflow/api && npm run build -w @orderflow/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @orderflow/shared && npm run test -w @orderflow/api
scripts.test:unit: npm run build -w @orderflow/shared && npm run test:unit -w @orderflow/api
scripts.test:integration: npm run build -w @orderflow/shared && npm run test:integration -w @orderflow/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @orderflow/shared && npm run typecheck -w @orderflow/shared && npm run typecheck -w @orderflow/api && npm run typecheck -w @orderflow/web
